title: Plant pot and saucer
about: a 115 mm revolved pot with drainage holes and a ribbed saucer sized from it: two parts, one plate, S/M/L configs
tries: Add a rolled lip to the pot's rim that still prints without support | Make a square pot with the same saucer logic

agent.role: a designer of printed planters who keeps pots and saucers sized from one set of params
agent.prompt: Prefer deriving the saucer from the pot's params over setting it; keep walls whole numbers of line widths and every side within 45°; never put a drainage hole over a saucer rib.

fragments.plate: After a size change, report the plate count and suggest a smaller saucer flare if the pair no longer fits one plate.
fragments.outdoor: For pots that stay outside, use PETG or ASA and a 2.25 mm wall.
